summaries.title: Out of Sight but Not Out of Mind: Hybrid Memory for Dynamic Video World Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」痛点，作者围绕 **Hybrid** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖世界模型（World Model）。核心论点主张：To address this, we introduce Hybrid Memory, a novel paradigm requiring models to simultaneously act as precise archivists for static backgrounds and vigilant trackers for...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **HM-World**。实验设计与验证细节：To facilitate research in this direction, we construct HM-World, the first large-scale video dataset dedicated to hybrid memory。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive experiments on HM-World demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both dynamic subject consistency and overall generation quality）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为社区高关注度代表作（HF 124 赞，出自 H-EmbodVis），本工作为突破 **视频生成与交互世界模型 (Video & World Models)** 中的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: ShotStream: Streaming Multi-Shot Video Generation for Interactive Storytelling
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销、显存占用与端侧资源受限」痛点，作者围绕 **ShotStream** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖旋转位置编码（Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)）。核心论点主张：We propose ShotStream, a novel causal multi-shot architecture that enables interactive storytelling and efficient on-the-fly frame generation。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用分阶段渐进式训练/建模流水线、师生知识蒸馏与能力迁移、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **single GPU**。实验设计与验证细节：By reformulating the task as next-shot generation conditioned on historical context, ShotStream allows users to dynamically instruct ongoing...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive experiments demonstrate that ShotStream generates coherent multi-shot videos with sub-second latency, achieving 16 FPS on a single GPU）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为社区高关注度代表作（HF 100 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)、视频生成与交互世界模型 (Video & World Models)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: PackForcing: Short Video Training Suffices for Long Video Sampling and Long Context Inference
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**高效推理与系统**（Efficiency & Sys）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」痛点，作者围绕 **PackForcing** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖旋转位置编码（Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)）、键值缓存（KV Cache）、扩散模型（Diffusion Model）。核心论点主张：To address these challenges, we present PackForcing, a unified framework that efficiently manages the generation history through a novel three-partition KV-cache strategy。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、高质量合成数据构造与精选配比、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **H200**。实验设计与验证细节：Specifically, we categorize the historical context into three distinct types: (1) Sink tokens, which preserve early anchor frames at full resolution...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **32x, 24x**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive results on VBench demonstrate state-of-the-art temporal consistency (26.07) and dynamic degree (56.25), proving that short-video supervision is sufficient for high-quality,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 23 赞，出自 Shanda AI Research Tokyo），本工作为突破 **KV缓存压缩与推测解码 (KV & Speculative)、视频生成与交互世界模型 (Video & World Models)** 中的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: MedOpenClaw: Auditable Medical Imaging Agents Reasoning over Uncurated Full Studies
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖、系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **MedOpenClaw** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model (VLM)）、工具调用（Tool Use）。核心论点主张：To address this, we propose MEDOPENCLAW, an auditable runtime designed to let VLMs operate dynamically within standard medical tools or viewers (e.g., 3D Slicer)。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：On top of this runtime, we introduce MEDFLOWBENCH, a full-study medical imaging benchmark covering multi-sequence brain MRI and lung CT/PET。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Initial results reveal a critical insight: while state-of-the-art LLMs/VLMs (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Pro and GPT-5.4) can successfully navigate the viewer to solve basic study-level tasks,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 0 赞），本工作为突破 **视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)、智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)** 中的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供项目主页与可视化案例参考。
